name: browser-use
headline: app-store-screenshot-studio: create compliant sets
short_description: Automates App Store Connect-ready screenshot generation with Apple compliance checks. Benefits operations teams by streamlining visual asset creation for app store submissions. Connects to App Store Connect and integrates with design workflows.
author: gitethanwoo

sections.overview:
App Store Screenshot Studio automates the creation of App Store Connect-ready screenshot sets by orchestrating Apple compliance checks, screenshot capture via Xcode, marketing compositing via Nano Banana Pro, and validation before packaging. The skill enforces App Review guidelines including proper app representation, required IAP disclosures, correct pixel dimensions, and fictional data usage. It eliminates manual asset creation workflows by automating the entire pipeline from storyboard planning through final validation, helping operations and development teams submit screenshots that meet Apple's strict requirements on the first attempt.
Generate compliant iOS app screenshots for App Store submission
Create marketing composites from raw simulator screenshots
Validate screenshot dimensions and Apple compliance before upload
Automate screenshot capture across multiple device categories
